items.title: Restraint Abliteration - Rotating Keys, Broken Guardrails
items.summary:
From autocorrect to full-fledged conversationalists, discover how a few tweaks transformed language models—and why understanding this shift exposes urgent questions about AI safety and control.
• Trusting an open source AI proxy might bite you.
• France's under-15 social media ban hits its constitution.
• A bit of AI prompting found a serious bug in Zoom.
• AI-based network defenders see a stock price jump.
• A (very) deep dive into the operation of AI chatbots

Show Notes - https://www.grc.com/sn/SN-1092-Notes.pdf

Hosts: Steve Gibson and Leo Laporte
